Marta (PM): Quick sync — we need a trimmed minimal surface for Console observability alpha. Customers want: dashboards, per-route cost breakdown, basic tracing hooks, and error analytics. Can we agree what 'alpha' must include?
Connor (Eng): Agree on the list. My priority is low-friction telemetry that doesn't add >5ms p95 to requests. Suggest: request latency, success/error count, token_count, and a small set of trace spans for inference lifecycle.
Zoe (SRE): +1. Also need retention defaults and ingestion budget estimate. Ideally 30d retention for high-cardinality traces is optional. Keep default metrics 90d.
Jae (Eng): For tracing hooks, propose we capture: request_id, customer_id (hashed), model_id, model_variant, prompt_token_count, response_token_count, backend_latency, total_latency. Instrumentation points: incoming HTTP -> request dispatch -> model runtime entry -> model runtime exit -> response send.
Marta (PM): That instrumentation list looks good. Customers asked specifically for per-route cost breakdown. Connor — can we surface per-route token cost (tokens * model_cost_per_1k) in dashboards without heavy aggregation work?
Connor (Eng): Yes, we can emit metric: redwood.console.cost.per_route with tags: route, model_id, model_variant. Calculation on emitter side: cost = (prompt_tokens + completion_tokens) * cost_per_1k / 1000. We'll include cost_code path in SDK and runtime.
Zoe (SRE): For aggregation, keep cardinality low: route and model_id only; avoid free-text prompts as tags. We'll store per-route daily rollups for cost to keep storage bounded.
Marta (PM): Launch criteria proposal for alpha: 1) Dashboard with top 10 routes by cost and latency, 2) Tracing hooks present and sample rate adjustable, 3) Error analytics surface for 5 most common errors with sample stack/traces, 4) Ingest costs estimated and within our budget forecast, 5) Docs + quickstart for customers to opt-in. Thumbs?
Jae (Eng): thumbs up. Add: instrumentation must include an easy config flag to enable/disable tracing at workspace-level and route-level. Also need a canary rollout plan.
Connor (Eng): Canary: enable for 10% traffic for two days, monitor overhead and error surface. If overhead <5ms and no error regression, expand to 50% then 100%. We'll have automatic rollback if error_rate increases >1.5x baseline. deploy-bot: Canary started for feature/console-instrumentation on cluster-prod-canary at 2026-03-10T16:30:00Z
Zoe (SRE): Ops asks: add SLI for observability ingestion latency (time from event -> visible on dashboard < 2 min p95) and monitoring for costs ingestion pipeline failures.
Marta (PM): Scope negotiation: customers want per-model quantized cost breakdown, but that increases cardinality. Proposal: treat per-model breakdown as beta behind feature flag and charge for higher retention. Decisions?
Connor (Eng): I support beta behind flag. Implementation: emit model_version tag only when workspace opts into "detailed_model_breakdown". Default: model_id only.
Jae (Eng): Also propose lightweight error analytics: surface error type, count, and one representative example per error type (redact PII). Full stack traces available only if workspace enables `share_traces` setting.
Marta (PM): Good. Timeboxed tasks for next 2 sprints: sprint 1 (2 weeks): basic metrics emitters, dashboard skeleton, tracing hook with sample_rate config, canary infra. sprint 2: per-route cost rollups, error analytics UI, retention controls and docs.
Zoe (SRE): I'll own retention defaults and pipeline SLIs. Connor/Jae own instrumentation and emitter SDK. Marta will drive docs and customer comms.
Marta (PM): Risks: high-cardinality events, storage overrun, added latency. Mitigations: conservative default sample rate (0.1), tag limits, and daily rollups.
Connor (Eng): We'll add runtime guardrail: if trace emission queue > 1k pending, drop non-essential spans and flag. Also emit drop metrics so we can monitor.
Marta (PM): One more ask — customer-facing acceptance criteria: provide a short checklist for customers that maps to our internal launch criteria. I'll draft and post here.
Jae (Eng): Sample trace header we should document for instrumenters:
```
traceparent: 00-4bf92f3577b34da6a3ce929d0e0e4736-00f067aa0ba902b7-01
X-Request-ID: {{request_id}}
X-Model-ID: {{model_id}}
X-Model-Version: {{model_version}}
```
Marta (PM): Perfect. I'll follow up with a wireframe for the dashboard (top routes, cost trend, error slice) by EOD Friday.
Connor (Eng): Thanks. I'll add the emitter PR to the eng-runtime board and tag the SRE reviewers.
deploy-bot: Deployed feature/console-instrumentation-canary to prod-canary at 2026-03-10T16:31:02Z
Zoe (SRE): Leaving a note — when we enable per-route cost calculation, we should validate with billing team so numbers align with invoice.
Marta (PM): Noted. We'll sync with finance before beta. Good sync everyone. I'll create a follow-up doc with milestones and owners. :raised_hands:
